description: This file contains utility functions and dependencies management for Playwright, including platform-specific dependency installation, version handling, and system checks.

methods.name: writeDockerVersion
methods.description: Writes Docker version info to a file, creating directories as needed and setting permissions.

methods.name: dockerVersion
methods.description: Generates Docker image name with current version info.

methods.name: readDockerVersionSync
methods.description: Reads Docker version info from file synchronously.

methods.name: installDependenciesWindows
methods.description: Installs Windows dependencies for specified target groups, optionally in dry run mode.

methods.name: installDependenciesLinux
methods.description: Installs Linux dependencies for specified target groups, optionally in dry run mode.

methods.name: validateDependenciesWindows
methods.description: Checks for missing Windows dependencies and provides guidance or throws errors.

methods.name: validateDependenciesLinux
methods.description: Checks for missing Linux dependencies and provides guidance or throws errors.
